map.算法：所需功率 P = T×n/9550（kW）；计算: Algorithm: required power P = T times n / 9550 (kW);
map.Pm = P×安全系数；按标准功率系列（0.75…400kW）向上取档；极数按转: Pm = P times safety factor; round up to the standard power series (0.75 to 400 kW); poles from speed (at least 2500 to 2 poles, at least 1200 to 4 poles, at least 800 to 6 poles, at least 600 to 8 poles, at least 450 to 10 poles, otherwise 12 poles); series by voltage (at or below 220 V single-phase YC/YU, at or below 400 V three-phase low-voltage YE3/YE4); cos phi and eta by power band (below 2.2 kW 0.78/0.78, below 11 kW 0.82/0.85, below 55 kW 0.85/0.90, otherwise 0.88/0.93); rated current I = P times 1000 / (sqrt(3) times U times cos phi times eta); synchronous speed n1 = 120 f / p, slip s = (n1 minus n) / n1 times 100 percent.
map.例：负载转矩 100N·m、1450rpm、380V、安全系数 1.2 → 所需: Example: load torque 100 N·m, 1450 rpm, 380 V, safety factor 1.2 gives required power 15.18 kW, computed power 18.22 kW, round up to 18.5 kW, 4 poles, YE3/YE4 three-phase low-voltage, cos phi 0.85, eta 0.90, rated current 36.7 A, load rate 82.1 percent. If 30 N·m, 2900 rpm gives required 9.11 kW, computed 10.93 kW, take 11 kW, 2 poles, current 21.8 A, load rate 82.8 percent.

map.同步转速与转差率怎么算？: How to compute synchronous speed and slip?
map.同步转速 n₁ = 120f/p（f 为电源频率 Hz，p 为极数）：50Hz: Synchronous speed n1 = 120 f / p (f is supply frequency Hz, p is pole count): at 50 Hz, 2 poles 3000, 4 poles 1500, 6 poles 1000, 8 poles 750 rpm. This tool first judges poles from actual speed, then computes n1; slip s = (n1 minus n) / n1 times 100 percent; for example a 1450 rpm 4-pole motor has s = (1500 minus 1450) / 1500 = 3.3 percent, generally asynchronous motors have rated slip of 1 percent to 6 percent.
